# event-sourcing-mini

> Minimal event sourcing: append-only streams with optimistic concurrency, global positions, projections with checkpoints and snapshots, in memory or SQLite Python package `trysac-event-sourcing-mini`, import name `event_sourcing_mini`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
